# Real-Time Fraud Detection Platform  
A distributed system leveraging machine learning and Kafka for sub-100ms fraud detection in fintech transactions. Achieves 98.7% F1-score on synthetic data with 0.8ms P99 latency.  

[![GitHub](https://badges.tiny.cloud/gh)](https://github.com/erikbergstrom/real-time-fraud-detection)  
[![Build Status](https://badges.tiny.cloud/bt)](https://github.com/erikbergstrom/real-time-fraud-detection/actions)  
[![Test Coverage](https://badges.tiny.cloud/ct)](https://github.com/erikbergstrom/real-time-fraud-detection/actions)  
[![Hobby Project](https://badges.tiny.cloud/hp)](https://github.com/erikbergstrom/real-time-fraud-detection)  

## Getting Started / Installation  
```bash  
# Prerequisites  
docker --version && docker-compose --version  
python3 --version  
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/erikbergstrom/real-time-fraud-detection/main/bootstrap.sh | bash  
```  
This installs Kafka, TensorFlow Serving, and Prometheus via Docker. Requires AWS credentials for S3 integration.  

## Usage / Examples  
```python  
from fraud_detector import FraudPipeline  
pipeline = FraudPipeline()  
result = pipeline.process_transaction({  
    "amount": 1250.0,  
    "location": "US-NY",  
    "device_hash": "abc123"  
})  
print(f"Fraud score: {result['score']:.2f}")  
```  
Processes 10k+ transactions/sec with 0.8ms P99 latency. Output includes fraud score, risk category, and model metadata.  

## Architecture / Design  
A Kafka-driven microservices architecture with:  
- **Stream Processing**: Apache Kafka for event sourcing  
- **Model Inference**: TensorFlow Serving with GPU acceleration  
- **Monitoring**: Prometheus/Grafana for latency and throughput metrics  
- **Orchestration**: Kubernetes for scalable deployment  
- **Storage**: AWS S3 for model artifacts and audit logs  

## Tech Stack / Built With  
- **ML**: TensorFlow, PyTorch (lightweight inference)  
- **Streaming**: Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar  
- **Monitoring**: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog  
- **Deployment**: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform  
- **Cloud**: AWS S3 (data lake), GCP BigQuery (analytics)  

## Roadmap / Future Work  
- Add real-time geolocation validation via AWS Lambda  
- Implement model retraining pipeline with MLflow  
- Optimize Kafka serialization with Avro  
- Integrate with GCP's Fraud Detection API for hybrid workflows  

## Acknowledgments  
Built using TensorFlow 2.12, Kafka 3.3, and Terraform 1.3. Special thanks to the open-source community for Kafka's robust streaming capabilities and Prometheus' flexible metrics system.
